Risk Description: Unauthorized access to ePHI due to excessive permissions
Control Gap: Some users retain broader access than necessary
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly access reviews and enforce minimum necessary access

Risk Description: Former employee retains access to ePHI systems
Control Gap: Access removal is not always validated promptly
Recommended Remediation: Automate account disablement and review terminated-user access
Perform annual security reviews of high-risk business associates

Risk Description: Incident response failure delays containment of ePHI breach
Control Gap: Tabletop exercises are not performed consistently
Recommended Remediation: Conduct annual incident response exercises and document lessons learned

Risk Description: Incomplete HIPAA security risk analysis misses new threats
Control Gap: Risk analysis is not updated consistently
Recommended Remediation: Perform formal risk analysis annually and after significant changes

Risk Description: Security risks remain unresolved due to weak remediation tracking
Control Gap: Owners timelines and closure evidence are inconsistent
Recommended Remediation: Create formal risk treatment tracking with assigned owners and due dates

Risk Description: Backup restoration failure prevents access to ePHI
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly backup restoration testing and document recovery results

Risk Description: Suspicious access to ePHI goes undetected
Control Gap: Recurring log review evidence is incomplete
Recommended Remediation: Document recurring audit-log reviews and retain investigation records

Risk Description: Compromised credentials allow unauthorized remote or privileged access
Existing Control: MFA is enabled for some accounts
Control Gap: MFA is not enforced for all privileged and remote access
Recommended Remediation: Require MFA for all privileged and remote access accounts

Risk Description: Improper device disposal exposes residual ePHI
Recommended Remediation: Maintain disposal logs and media sanitization records

Risk Description: Emergency access procedures fail during a disruption
Inadequate physical security assurance at cloud provider
Control Gap: Provider physical security reports have not been formally reviewed
Recommended Remediation: Review cloud provider attestations and compliance reports

Risk Description: Loss of ePHI integrity due to unauthorized alteration
Control Gap: Integrity monitoring is not independently reviewed
Recommended Remediation: Review integrity controls and change records periodically
